title: Returning Borrower Credit on Rate Lock Commitment Extension Rates
content:
### Returning borrowers and the Rate Lock Commitment extension rate

A borrower who has already closed a loan with Larkspur receives a credit against the per-day cost of an extension, in basis points. The adjusted per-day cost is never taken below zero. The basis is the customer's other **Mortgage Loan File** records: a file in consummated status, and the date it closed.

**Rule.**

- When the customer holds another Larkspur loan file in consummated status that closed fewer than **36** months (the recent-return months) before today, the recent-return credit of **0.25** basis points is subtracted.
- When that consummated file closed 36 months or more before today, the return credit of **0.125** basis points is subtracted.
- Otherwise no returning-borrower credit applies.

Months are counted in whole calendar months from the closed date to today.

| Customer's other Larkspur loan file | Closed | Credit subtracted (basis points) |
|---|---|---|
| Consummated | Fewer than 36 months before today | 0.25 |
| Consummated | 36 months or more before today | 0.125 |
| None in consummated status | — | 0 |

*Boundary cases (hypothetical, today 15 June 2025):* a file consummated and closed 16 June 2022 has completed 35 whole months, so the credit is 0.25. Closed 15 June 2022, it has completed 36 months, so the credit is 0.125. A file that was withdrawn or denied is not consummated, and gives no credit.
